events.name: Green Monday
events.desc: Clean Monday marks the start of Lent. Families head to the countryside for picnics and kite flying. A public holiday.
events.sourceName: Central Bank of Cyprus: bank holidays 2027

events.name: Orthodox Easter
events.desc: The biggest celebration of the Cypriot year: Good Friday processions, the midnight Resurrection service with bonfires, then Easter Sunday feasts. Easter Sunday is 2 May.
events.sourceName: Central Bank of Cyprus: bank holidays 2027

events.name: Kataklysmos, the Festival of the Flood
events.desc: Pentecost Monday, celebrated by the sea. Larnaca's seafront usually hosts the biggest festivities, with water games, music and stalls around the holiday.
events.sourceName: Central Bank of Cyprus: bank holidays 2027

events.name: Agros Christmas Village
events.recurrence: Selected weekends and Fridays, then daily from 21 December
events.desc: One of the nine official Christmas villages: festive stalls, local food and activities for all ages in Agros.

events.name: Limassol Carnival
events.desc: Eleven days of costumes, parties and parades, ending with the Grand Carnival Parade on Sunday 14 March.
events.sourceName: Limassol Tourism Board

events.name: Bank of Cyprus Nicosia Marathon
events.desc: Marathon and shorter races through the capital, starting and finishing at Eleftheria Square. Expect road closures in the centre.
events.sourceName: Visit Cyprus

events.name: TUI Cyprus Marathon
events.desc: A Paphos running weekend: a 5km sunset race on Saturday, then the marathon from Aphrodite's Rock and shorter races on Sunday, finishing at Paphos Castle.
events.sourceName: TUI

events.name: XM Limassol Marathon
events.desc: A seafront running weekend with the marathon and shorter races along Limassol's promenade.
events.sourceName: Visit Cyprus

events.name: Fengaros Music Festival
events.desc: Three nights of live music under the stars. The 2026 edition was at Petrides Farm Park in Marki; the 2027 venue is still to be announced.
events.sourceName: Politis

events.name: Robbie Williams in Larnaca
events.desc: Larnaca Municipality expects Robbie Williams to play on the Larnaca to Dhekelia road next summer. The promoter hasn't confirmed it yet.
events.sourceName: Greek City Times

events.name: Agros Rose Festival
events.desc: The mountain village celebrates its famous roses: rose picking, rose water distilling, markets and live music.
events.sourceName: Politis (2026 edition)

events.name: Kataklysmos Festival, Larnaca
events.desc: Larnaca's Festival of the Flood takes over the seafront for several days with water games, music and stalls.
events.sourceName: Larnaka Tourism Board (2026 edition)

events.name: Pafos Aphrodite Festival
events.desc: Open-air opera in Paphos. The 2026 production was Donizetti's L'elisir d'amore.
events.sourceName: Visit Cyprus (2026 edition)

events.name: Limassol Wine Festival
events.desc: Cyprus's best known festival celebrates local wine with tastings, music and dancing.
events.sourceName: Cyprus Mail (2026 edition)

events.name: Ayia Napa International Festival
events.desc: The town's big cultural festival with performances, music and Cypriot traditions.
events.sourceName: Cyprus Mail

events.name: Ayia Napa Medieval Festival
events.desc: Knights, music and medieval performances around the old monastery. The 2026 edition honoured the queens of Cyprus.
events.sourceName: Cyprus Mail (2026 edition)

events.name: Ayia Napa Marina Christmas Village
events.desc: A seaside Christmas village with a market, Santa's grotto, free kids' workshops, live music, dance and magic shows, and Christmas films in the evenings.
events.price: Free entry and kids' workshops; adult workshops and cinema are paid
events.sourceName: Ayia Napa Marina, plus its published programme
